read-update-pdf-metadata.title: Update PDF Metadata with PdfFileInfo
read-update-pdf-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, read its existing metadata, modify Title, Author, and Subject, and save the changes using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.

read-pdf-author-metadata.title: Read PDF Author Metadata with PdfFileInfo
read-pdf-author-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and retrieve the Author metadata property, outputting it to the console.

read-pdf-title-metadata-log.title: Read PDF Title Metadata and Write to Log
read-pdf-title-metadata-log.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to read the Title metadata from a PDF file and append it to a log file.

retrieve-pdf-keywords-metadata.title: Read PDF Keywords Metadata with PdfFileInfo
retrieve-pdf-keywords-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to retrieve the Keywords metadata field from a PDF without loading the full document.

read-pdf-creator-metadata.title: Read PDF Creator Metadata with PdfFileInfo
read-pdf-creator-metadata.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to access the Creator metadata field of a PDF document.

read-pdf-modification-date.title: Read PDF Modification Date with PdfFileInfo
read-pdf-modification-date.description: Shows how to obtain the ModDate metadata from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, parse the PDF date string, and format it for display.

set-pdf-keywords-metadata.title: Set PDF Keywords Metadata Using PdfFileInfo
set-pdf-keywords-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to assign the Keywords metadata field of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, save the updated file, and verify the change.

set-pdf-creator-metadata.title: Set Custom Creator Metadata in PDF
set-pdf-creator-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to assign a custom Creator value to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and persist the change with SaveNewInfo.

add-custom-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add Custom Metadata to PDF using PdfFileInfo
add-custom-metadata-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a custom metadata entry to a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf.Facades PdfFileInfo and save the modified document.

retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata.title: Retrieve Custom PDF Metadata (ProjectCode) using Aspose.Pdf
retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to read a custom metadata entry named "ProjectCode" from a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileInfo class without loading the full document.

add-custom-metadata-reviewedby-to-pdf.title: Add Custom 'ReviewedBy' Metadata to PDF
add-custom-metadata-reviewedby-to-pdf.description: Shows how to add a custom metadata field named "ReviewedBy" to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades PdfFileInfo and persist the changes to a new file.

retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata-reviewedby.title: Retrieve Custom PDF Metadata (ReviewedBy) with Aspose.Pdf
retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata-reviewedby.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to read a custom metadata entry named "ReviewedBy" from a PDF file and log it for audit purposes.

add-department-metadata-to-pdfs.title: Add Custom Department Metadata to PDFs
add-department-metadata-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates looping through PDF files, adding a custom "Department" metadata field with Aspose.Pdf.Facades, and saving the updated PDFs.

add-custom-metadata-field-to-pdf.title: Update PDF Metadata with a Version Field
add-custom-metadata-field-to-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, adds or updates a custom metadata entry named "Version" while preserving all other metadata, and saves the result to a new file.

remove-custom-pdf-metadata-entry.title: Clear Obsolete Custom Metadata Field from PDF
remove-custom-pdf-metadata-entry.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF with PdfFileInfo, remove a specific custom metadata entry by setting its value to an empty string, and save the updated document.

read-custom-pdf-metadata-existence-check.title: Read Custom PDF Metadata Safely
read-custom-pdf-metadata-existence-check.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, verify the presence of a custom metadata key, and read its value only if it exists.

add-lastupdated-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add Custom 'LastUpdated' Metadata to PDF
add-lastupdated-metadata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to set a custom metadata field with the current UTC timestamp using Aspose.Pdf.Facades PdfFileInfo and save the updated PDF.

update-pdf-metadata-save-new-file.title: Update PDF Metadata with PdfFileInfo SaveNewInfo
update-pdf-metadata-save-new-file.description: Shows how to load a PDF, modify its title, author, subject, and keywords, and save the updated metadata using PdfFileInfo.SaveNewInfo.

load-pdf-retrieve-file-info-and-save.title: Read PDF Metadata and Add a Page using Aspose.Pdf
load-pdf-retrieve-file-info-and-save.description: Shows how to retrieve PDF file information with PdfFileInfo and modify the document by adding a blank page and saving it, using using blocks for proper disposal.

backup-and-update-pdf-metadata.title: Backup PDFs and Update Metadata with PdfFileInfo
backup-and-update-pdf-metadata.description: Creates a backup copy of each PDF in a folder, then uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to modify the title, author, and subject metadata of the original files.

audit-pdf-metadata-to-csv.title: Capture, Update, and Audit PDF Metadata with CSV
audit-pdf-metadata-to-csv.description: The example reads a PDF's original metadata using PdfFileInfo, updates the metadata via Document.Info, saves the modified PDF, and logs both original and new values to a CSV file for auditing.

handle-readonly-file-errors-when-saving-.title: Update PDF Metadata with Read‑Only File Handling
handle-readonly-file-errors-when-saving-.description: Demonstrates how to modify PDF document information using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and gracefully handle an IOException caused by a read‑only file attribute, including clearing the attribute and retrying.

update-pdf-metadata-memorystream.title: Update PDF Metadata Using MemoryStream and PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-metadata-memorystream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a memory stream, modifying its metadata (title, author, subject, keywords) with PdfFileInfo, and saving the updated document to a new file.

update-pdf-keywords-metadata.title: Update PDF Keywords Metadata Using PdfFileInfo Stream
update-pdf-keywords-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF from a read‑only stream with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, modify the Keywords metadata field, and save the updated document to a new file.

update-pdf-author-metadata-conditional.title: Update PDF Author Metadata Conditionally
update-pdf-author-metadata-conditional.description: Shows how to read the Author metadata of a PDF, set it only when the field is empty, and save the modified document to a new file.

list-custom-pdf-metadata-keys.title: Retrieve Custom PDF Metadata Keys Alphabetically
list-custom-pdf-metadata-keys.description: The example loads a PDF, filters out standard metadata entries, and lists all custom metadata keys in alphabetical order along with their values.

merge-xmp-metadata-with-pdf-fileinfo.title: Merge XMP Metadata Packet into PDF Document
merge-xmp-metadata-with-pdf-fileinfo.description: Shows how to load an XMP packet, extract simple properties, register a custom namespace, and merge those values into a PDF's metadata using Aspose.Pdf.

read-pdf-version.title: Read PDF Version Number Using Aspose.Pdf
read-pdf-version.description: Shows how to load a PDF file and retrieve its version string with Aspose.Pdf's Document class (optionally using PdfFileInfo for additional metadata).

export-pdf-metadata-to-json.title: Export PDF Metadata to JSON
export-pdf-metadata-to-json.description: Iterates over PDF files in a folder, extracts their document information with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, and writes the collected metadata to a JSON file for external processing.

import-json-metadata-to-pdf.title: Import JSON Metadata and Apply to PDFs
import-json-metadata-to-pdf.description: Reads a JSON file containing PDF metadata entries and applies the specified title, author, subject, keywords, and creation date to each PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.

apply-metadata-changes-to-multiple-pdfs-.title: Parallel Batch Update of PDF Metadata
apply-metadata-changes-to-multiple-pdfs-.description: Demonstrates how to apply metadata changes to multiple PDF files concurrently using the Task Parallel Library and Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.

thread-safe-parallel-pdf-metadata-update.title: Thread‑Safe PDF Metadata Update and Text Stamp
thread-safe-parallel-pdf-metadata-update.description: Demonstrates processing multiple PDF files concurrently, updating their title metadata and adding a centered text stamp using Aspose.Pdf while ensuring thread‑safe console logging.

validate-set-pdf-metadata-with-regex.title: Validate and Set PDF Metadata with Regex
validate-set-pdf-metadata-with-regex.description: Demonstrates how to validate metadata strings using a regular expression and then assign Title, Author, and Subject to a PDF via Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.

read-pdf-metadata-with-null-handling.title: Read PDF Metadata with Null Handling
read-pdf-metadata-with-null-handling.description: Shows how to read standard PDF metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and gracefully handle missing or empty values.

update-pdf-subject-metadata.title: Update PDF Subject Metadata with PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-subject-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, modify its Subject metadata field using PdfFileInfo, and save the updated document.

set-pdf-language-property.title: Set PDF Language Property Using Tagged Content
set-pdf-language-property.description: Demonstrates how to read basic PDF metadata with PdfFileInfo and set the document language to "en-US" using the TaggedContent API, then save the updated PDF.

update-pdf-author-metadata__v3.title: Update PDF Author Metadata with PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-author-metadata__v3.description: Demonstrates how to bind to an existing PDF, change its Author metadata, and persist the change using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.

update-pdf-title-metadata__v2.title: Update PDF Title Metadata with PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-title-metadata__v2.description: Demonstrates how to modify the Title property of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and save the updated metadata to a new file without re‑saving the whole document.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b-using-pdffileinfo.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A‑1b Compliance
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b-using-pdffileinfo.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and convert it to PDF/A‑1b archival format using the Document.Convert method.
